messages:
amy.lewin: Quick thread to lock down embeddings GA scope. Customer asks have pushed this to top — we need clear decisions on dims, batching, and response shape by EOD

ravi.kumar: tl;dr: customer wants 4k dims and 10k-item batches. Ops says cost will explode. We should propose a tiered plan.

jordan.w: +1 on tiered. Proposal: GA supports 1536 (default) and 2048 (standard tier). 4096+ only via Dedicated/Private and enterprise contract.

kai.sato: For batching: realistic internal perf shows stable latency up to ~1024 vectors per request on our Dedicated hardware. 10k is unrealistic for hosted API without special sharding.

amy.lewin: So action: we need a documented limit for hosted API and an enterprise path. Draft idea: hosted max_batch_items = 1024, enterprise on Dedicated = 10k with API flag.

nora.d: UX/response format: customers want per-item metadata (id, status, embedding). Two patterns: matrix-only (fastest) vs items-with-metadata (slower). Which do we standardize on?

ben.platform: My vote: default response = minimal matrix (embeddings only) for perf. Optional param `include_metadata=true` returns items array with id + embedding + model + warnings. Keeps perf whilst supporting richer workflows.

ravi.kumar: API sketch:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model":"rwd-embed-1536", "inputs":[...], "include_metadata": false }
```
response (default):
```json
{ "model":"rwd-embed-1536", "embedding_shape":[N,1536], "embeddings": [[...],[...]] }
```
include_metadata=true:
```json
{ "data": [{"id":"1","embedding":[...],"warnings":[]}, ...] }
```

jordan.w: Love the opt-in. Also recommend `embedding_dtype` maybe `float32` vs `float16` in the future; but don't block GA on that.

kai.sato: Launch criteria (proposal):
- Support 1536 & 2048 models on hosted API
- hosted max_batch_items = 1024; per-minute quota to prevent accidental spikes
- response default = embeddings matrix; include_metadata opt-in
- perf SLO: single-vector p50 < 40ms, p95 < 200ms; batch (1024) throughput target >= X vectors/sec on our config
- regression tests vs baseline with 10 sample prompts

amy.lewin: Customer-facing requirements: docs + migration guide from single-vector to matrix/batched, pricing note for large batches, and sample SDK code (python/js). Also need clear error for requests > max_batch_items.

nora.d: Also add evals for semantic similarity across dims (1536 vs 2048) — we need to publish recommended model for retrieval vs semantic search. Put ML folks on cadence to run benchmarks.

ben.platform: Implementation notes: router needs to reject >1024 unless `enterprise=true` header + enterprise account. We can implement quick check in API proxy. Also record `batch_items` metric per request.

ravi.kumar: Cost considerations: 2048 dims ~2x tokens/cost compared to 1536. We should expose estimated cost in response header for billing preview `X-Estimate-Cost-Units`.

amy.lewin: Prioritization: GA (MVP) = {1536 default, 2048 optional, matrix default, include_metadata opt-in, hosted batch limit 1024}. Enterprise follow-up = {4096 support, 10k batches, custom shapes}.

jordan.w: Timeline ask: can ENG get a tech spec by Wed, implementation by end of sprint, docs + SDK samples within next week after that?

kai.sato: I'll draft tech spec today — include perf targets + proxy checks + e2e tests.

ben.platform: I'll add feature flag work and metrics. deploy-bot: deployment window available Thu 02:00-04:00 UTC.

amy.lewin: Great — owners: Kai (tech spec + perf), Ravi (impl), Ben (proxy + metrics), Nora/Jordan (benchmarks & docs). I'll follow up with customer expectations and pricing language. :thumbsup:
